photos.file: Javan Pond-Heron - Surabaya - East Java MG 6063 (29187033724).jpg

photos.desc: A javan pond-heron (Ardeola speciosa) was eating a small fish for breakfast. Located in Rawagembol rice fields, Kebumen. The pond-herons are quite timid and can be approached up close.
